personality_one_liner: A pristine, trustworthy food and ingredient intelligence app delivering instant safety scores, dietary matching, and clean alternatives with native iOS refinement.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous iOS vertical rhythm, touch targets >= 44pt, and safe-area padding.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and floating bottom action bars over scrolling content.
Pair blur with translucent tinted base >= 70% opacity.
dont's: Never blur form fields or entire content regions.
Never stack more than 2 blur surfaces on a single screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens adhere to iOS-Native Clean guidelines. Implement safety color badges (Red #E53935, Orange #FB8C00, Yellow #FDD835, Light Green #7CB342, Emerald #2E7D32). Keep primary CTAs sticky at bottom with safe-area padding. Provide guest quota enforcement (3 free scans) before prompting Auth. Implement INR pricing and StoreKit microtransaction wallet logic.
